scripts.build: pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:workbench
scripts.format: biome check --write apps contracts scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json && gofmt -w cmd internal
scripts.format:check: biome format apps contracts scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json && node scripts/check-go-format.mjs
scripts.lint: biome lint apps contracts scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json && go vet ./...
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run contracts:check && pnpm run contracts:generate:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
